content: Standard pattern: define an abstract base (Protocol/ABC) per external dependency — LLMProvider (.generate_signal), Broker (.place_order/.get_positions/.get_balance), DataSource — and select the concrete impl via config (Claude vs OpenAI, mock vs real KIS). Orchestrator depends only on the interfaces. This is the classic Strategy/Adapter + dependency-injection structure used by trading bots (ccxt-style broker abstraction).
